# The Lab Fitness & Wellness

> The Lab is a 24/7 gym and wellness studio at 2912 Franklin Ave, Waco, TX 76710. Membership is $50 a month plus tax with a one-time $50 signup fee, no contract, and 24/7 key access. Memberships are limited so the floor never gets crowded. Independent personal trainers and a licensed massage therapist run their own practices at The Lab, and trainers pay no rent or fees.

Phone: (254) 722-9587
Email: josh@thelabwaco.com
Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week

## Membership

- [Membership](https://thelabwaco.com/#membership): $50/month + tax, one-time $50 signup fee, no contract, 24/7 key access, limited availability. New members join online through the VirtuaGym webshop.
- [24 hour gym in Waco](https://thelabwaco.com/24-hour-gym-waco.html): full detail on keyed 24-hour access and the no-contract, month-to-month terms, plus what is and is not included in the $50 membership. Serves Waco and nearby Woodway, Hewitt, Robinson, and Bellmead.
- Optional tools add-on: $10/month for InBody body-composition scans plus app and website tools.

## Services (optional, not included in membership)

- [Services overview](https://thelabwaco.com/services.html): what The Lab offers and how services relate to membership.
- [Personal training](https://thelabwaco.com/personal-training.html): one-on-one coaching with independent trainers who set their own rates and book directly.
- [Guided Training](https://thelabwaco.com/guided-training.html): The Lab's own coaching program, $100/month add-on. Kickoff InBody scan and goals intake, a custom training plan with personal macro targets in the app, monthly re-scan and program refresh, and coach messaging. Not in-person personal training.
- [Nutrition coaching](https://thelabwaco.com/nutrition-coaching.html): macro guidance included with Guided Training. General fitness guidance, not medical nutrition therapy.
- [Massage & recovery](https://thelabwaco.com/massage-recovery.html): sports massage, cupping, and Graston with Osiel Alvarez, LMT (Elite Athletic Bodywork), booked directly.
- [Wellness](https://thelabwaco.com/wellness.html): how gym access, coaching, bodywork, and progress tools fit together.

## People

- [Coaches & therapists](https://thelabwaco.com/coaches.html): the independent professionals practicing at The Lab.
- [Dayton Malone](https://thelabwaco.com/dayton.html): competition and lifestyle coaching.
- [Kelvin Robinson](https://thelabwaco.com/kelvin.html): HighPower Fitness, one-on-one coaching, group fitness, student-athlete performance.
- [Keenan Alford](https://thelabwaco.com/keenan.html): Reinforced Fitness, one-on-one personal training.
- [Osiel Alvarez, LMT](https://thelabwaco.com/osiel.html): Elite Athletic Bodywork, sports massage.

## For trainers

- [Train your clients at The Lab](https://thelabwaco.com/trainers.html): independent trainers pay no rent and no fees and keep 100% of their training income. Their clients hold an active $50/month gym membership. Trainers need an industry-recognized certification and their own liability insurance. Non-exclusive; trainers may work anywhere.
